suggestions.pitch: Jalen Hurts is a clear QB upgrade over Bryce Young at 19.3 a week, and the contending partner gets two WRs while Allgeier adds RB depth.
Sutton plus Harrison for Hurts and Strange upgrades my QB and TE-adjacent depth with a contender who values the receivers.
Sutton for Tua plus Pollard adds RB help and a QB with a decent likelihood of acceptance from a contending team.
